{{short description|Stage of the Copa Sudamericana}}
The '''2019 Copa Sudamericana first stage''' was played from 5 February to 8 May 2019.<ref name="calendar">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/calendario_2019_divulgacao_aprobado_14_08_2018_0.pdf|title=CALENDÁRIO 2019 CONMEBOL Libertadores – CONMEBOL Sudamericana – RECOPA|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref> A total of 44 teams competed in the first stage to decide 22 of the 32 places in the [[2019 Copa Sudamericana second stage|second stage]] of the [[2019 Copa Sudamericana]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/reglamento-conmebol-sudamericana-2019-esp.pdf|title=Reglamento CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2019|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|language=Spanish}}</ref>

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the first stage was held on 17 December 2018, 20:30 [[Time in Paraguay|PYST]] ([[UTC−03:00|UTC−3]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/el-17-de-diciembre-se-sortean-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-la-conmebol-sudamericana|title=El 17 de diciembre se sortean la CONMEBOL Libertadores y la CONMEBOL Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|language=Spanish|date=10 December 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/proceso-de-acreditacion-medios-de-prensa-para-el-sorteo-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-conmebol|title=Proceso de acreditación a medios de prensa para el sorteo de la CONMEBOL Libertadores y CONMEBOL Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|language=Spanish|date=12 December 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/se-conocen-los-emparejamientos-de-la-primera-fase-de-la-sudamericana|title=Se conocen los emparejamientos de la Primera Fase de la Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=17 December 2018}}</ref> For the first stage, the teams were divided into two pots according to their geographical zones:<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/pautas-de-sorteo-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-conmebol-sudamericana-2019|title=Pautas de sorteo de la CONMEBOL Libertadores y CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2019|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=17 December 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/pauta_sorteo_sudamericana_2019.pdf|title=CONMEBOL SUDAMERICANA 2019 Pauta del Sorteo|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref>
*'''Pot A (South Zone):''' 22 teams from Argentina, Bolivia, Chile, Paraguay, and Uruguay
*'''Pot B (North Zone):''' 22 teams from Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, and Venezuela

The 44 teams were drawn into 22 ties (E1–E22) between a team from Pot A and a team from Pot B, with the teams from Pot B hosting the second leg in odd-numbered ties, and the teams from Pot A hosting the second leg in even-numbered ties. This distribution ensured that teams from the same association could not be drawn into the same tie.<section end=Draw />

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
In the first stage, each tie was played on a home-and-away [[two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis. If tied on aggregate, the [[away goals rule]] was used. If still tied, [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] was not played, and a [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] was used to determine the winner (Regulations Article 27).<ref name="regulations"/>

The 22 winners of the first stage advanced to the [[2019 Copa Sudamericana second stage|second stage]] to join the 10 teams transferred from the [[2019 Copa Libertadores|Copa Libertadores]] (two [[2019 Copa Libertadores qualifying stages#Copa Sudamericana qualification|best teams]] eliminated in the [[2019 Copa Libertadores qualifying stages#Third stage|third stage]] of [[2019 Copa Libertadores qualifying stages|qualifying]] and eight third-placed teams in the [[2019 Copa Libertadores group stage|group stage]]).<section end=Format />

==Matches==
The first legs were played on 5–7, 12–14, 26 February, 19–21 March and 2–4 April, and the second legs were played on 19–21, 26–28 February, 21 March, 16–18, 30 April, 1–2 and 8 May 2019.<ref name="fixture">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/fixture-de-la-conmebol-sudamericana-2019|title=Fixture de la CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2019|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=18 December 2018}}</ref><ref name="fixture_pdf">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/fixture_sudamericana_v1_18122018.pdf|title=PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=18 December 2018}}</ref>
